answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the quill of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. A spiral of per-task receipts records who did what, and the canyon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
